profile.name: DG645数字延迟发生器
profile.description: 这是一台数字延迟发生器，用于在触发事件后输出具有可编程时间延迟的定时脉冲。该设备可配置延迟通道、触发源与触发速率、触发保持时间、突发模式，以及输出极性、幅度和偏置，常用于激光同步、时序分配和通用实验触发控制。
profile.description_en: This is a digital delay generator used to produce precisely timed pulses with programmable delays relative to a trigger event. It supports configuration of delay channels, trigger source and rate, trigger holdoff, burst mode, and output polarity, amplitude, and offset, making it useful for laser synchronization, timing distribution, and general experimental trigger control.
